body.message:
We completely understand your concern and appreciate your cooperation with the payments and your previous stay.

However, unfortunately, it will not be possible to proceed without the required advance payment arrangement. Please note that this policy has been updated based on the management's decision and is applicable to secure and guarantee the agreed extension rates.

If you would like to confirm and lock in the extension rates, we kindly request you to proceed as per the updated policy. Otherwise, we will not be able to guarantee the same rates for future extensions, as rates are subject to market conditions and availability.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
